title: the beginning of adoption and the measurement of the method: init, accept, the map as data, and the stand
intent: A method that keeps no account of what it cost cannot say what it is worth, and a method that cannot be adopted for one file is a method nobody will adopt. So this wave made the entry cost one file, gave the uncertainty a price and the person a way to take responsibility for it, made the map data as well as prose, and built the stand that measures the protocol on projects that are not this one.
objection: измерение стоимости требует рук человека, а руки человека в этом цикле нет
refuted_by: стоимость человека оказывается нулевой, и тогда её не надо измерять
